关键词: floating rate Cumulative Class A Preference Shares, Series 25
主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. (TSX: BAM.A, NYSE: BAM) announced on September 1, 2020, that it has determined the quarterly dividend on its floating rate Cumulative Class A Preference Shares, Series 25 (TSX: BAM.PR.S). The actual quarterly dividend rate was 0.61728% (2.449% annualized), with a dividend of $0.15432 per share payable on December 31, 2020. The dividend rate is based on the annual yield of three-month Government of Canada treasury bills, with an additional 2.30% annual rate. Brookfield Asset Management is a leading global alternative asset manager with approximately US$550 billion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power, private equity and credit.
